model.name: Owner-only access gate for Server Manager - server-side by-construction (owner 200 / non-owner 403, incl websocket)
model.description: The Server Manager UI AND every backing API/websocket are restricted to token 41ad88c4-4dee-49ac-afcb-8a2026657b2d, enforced SERVER-SIDE on every endpoint AND on the websocket handshake - the authenticated user's token is checked; anyone else gets 403 and never reaches the otmux/terminal APIs. UI-hiding alone is NOT acceptance. Correct-by-construction: a SINGLE owner-guard the endpoints share, not per-call ad-hoc checks. PAGE-ROUTE SCOPE (PO add 2026-07-20, architect forward-flag): R31.2's server-side owner-gate covers the /server-manager PAGE route itself (403/redirect for non-owner), not only /api/server-manager/* + the ws - the same shared assertOwner guard gates the page shell. Locked before R31.3/R31.4 build so the expert gates the page. COOKIE-ONLY AUTH (PO add 2026-07-20, architect security caveat): finish the ?token= removal - the /server-manager page route rejects ?token= (server.ts:917 fallback removed), the R31.1 renderFeatureGrants entry href drops its ?token= fallback, ?token= gone everywhere; cookie is the sole Server Manager auth path (residual token-in-URL leak). PO framed this as an R31.4 AC; req placed it in R31.2 (the owner-gate/auth requirement that owns page-route auth + AC-page-route + INV-G1/G2) - it is an auth-MECHANISM hardening, not terminal-specific (R31.4 ws already uses tickets). Sub-clause (b) href-emit is R31.1 renderFeatureGrants' surface - cross-referenced. WS GATE = sm_session COOKIE (architect clarify 2026-07-20): the same-origin cookie is the single credential for page+/tree+ws; ?ticket= SUPERSEDED. AC-ws-handshake + INV-G3 updated cookie-check.
model.tronQuote: > TRON (2026-07-20): ONLY this user gets a new Server Manager ... owner-token-gated at the websocket handshake, not just the page; no path to the APIs for any other user

discoverySource.note: Sprint 31 Server Manager (owner-gated infra console), Tron-authorized. Minted scenario-first. UC method-set design-ahead PROPOSED; architect confirms the hard parts (esp. R31.4 PTY bridge + auth). #126 scenario-first.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Owner check is SERVER-SIDE on every Server Manager endpoint; the authenticated token is the source of truth (not a client flag).
Requests from token 41ad88c4-4dee-49ac-afcb-8a2026657b2d to every Server Manager endpoint + ws handshake succeed (200 / ws upgrade).
Requests from ANY other authenticated token to every Server Manager endpoint AND the ws handshake return 403 and never reach otmux/terminal APIs.
A SINGLE shared owner-guard (one function/middleware) gates all endpoints + the ws handshake - correct-by-construction, not per-call ad-hoc checks.

The websocket is gated at the UPGRADE by the sm_session COOKIE (auto-sent same-origin), not merely the HTTP page: a non-owner / absent / invalid cookie gets 403 with the socket NEVER opening. ONE credential - the sm_session cookie - gates page + /tree + ws; the earlier single-use ?ticket= is SUPERSEDED by the cookie. Post-connect token checks are NOT acceptance.

The Server Manager PAGE route (e.g. /server-manager) is owner-gated SERVER-SIDE by the SAME shared assertOwner guard (single-literal): a non-owner request to the page route gets 403 (or a redirect away) and NEVER receives the page shell. Gating /api/server-manager/* + the ws ticket ALONE is NOT acceptance - the page itself is owner-only (Tron: 'ONLY this user will have access'). Client-side route-guarding / UI-hiding alone is NOT acceptance.
acceptanceCriteria.coverageNote: COVERED by Test 87b040ee (r312-owner-gate-security.mjs): /server-manager PAGE is in the shared assertOwner choke (server.ts:891-895, requireOwnerHttp gates the page before serving the shell) and the route-enumeration asserts /server-manager -> 403 non-owner + NEVER-leaks-shell (r312 lines 57,113-116). Same guard/Impl 335dbf3d as the APIs (INV-G1) - no separate hop. Coverable NOW, not a build item.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Server Manager auth is COOKIE-ONLY - no token-in-URL anywhere: (a) the /server-manager PAGE route REJECTS ?token= (the server.ts:917 query-token fallback removed - cookie is the sole auth path); (b) the profile entry href fallback carrying ?token= is removed (R31.1 renderFeatureGrants emits a CLEAN /server-manager href, no ?token=); (c) ?token= is GONE EVERYWHERE for Server Manager. Token-in-URL is a leak (server logs / browser history / referrer) and is rejected. Finishes the v0.7.89 cookie-primary move. Rides the same assertOwner guard (INV-G1) reading the cookie, single OWNER_TOKEN literal (INV-G2).
acceptanceCriteria.coverageNote: CODE-COMPLETE (measured, NOT a build item): resolveOwner (server.ts:817-820) auths via sm_session COOKIE + x-player-token HEADER only - NO ?token= query-auth path (the :917 fallback is removed); profile onclick navigates to a CLEAN /server-manager (line 874, cookie minted via header POST first, no ?token= in URL). All 3 sub-clauses (a page rejects ?token=, b clean href, c gone-everywhere) satisfied in code. Behaviorally covered by Test 87b040ee 403-enum (any request lacking a valid cookie/header -> 403 regardless of a URL ?token=). OPTIONAL: an explicit /server-manager?token=<owner> -> 403 assertion is a small tester slice - flag if PO wants it named; security property already enforced.
acceptanceCriteria.stagedNote: Explicit /server-manager?token=<owner> -> 403 (+ no shell leak) slice STAGED (marker b0ee7dc6) per PO 2026-07-20 — a security no-query-auth property gets an EXPLICIT test (correct-by-construction, guards a future ?token= regression), not just the behavioral 403-enum implication. Tester runs the slice with this marker; on GREEN req mints the slice Test onto Impl 335dbf3d (assertOwner, the guard that ignores URL tokens) + wires -> AC closes.

constructionInvariants.text: SINGLE guard, NO bypass: every Server Manager surface (page route /server-manager, /api/server-manager/*, and the ws ticket) passes through ONE choke-point (requireOwnerHttp/assertOwner). The page route has NO /api/ prefix, so the existing startsWith('/api/server-manager/') choke-point MUST be EXTENDED to also match '/server-manager' (gate both prefixes through the one guard) - NOT a second ad-hoc check. Stays on Impl 335dbf3d.
SINGLE OWNER_TOKEN literal: the owner token 41ad88c4-4dee-49ac-afcb-8a2026657b2d appears exactly ONCE (one shared constant the guard reads); no per-call/per-route re-literal of the token.

A REJECTED ws upgrade -> the socket NEVER opens and NO PTY is spawned (fail-closed at the handshake sm_session COOKIE check). Symmetric with the cookie-at-upgrade gating in AC-ws-handshake / R31.4 AC-ws-owner-gated. (?ticket= superseded by the cookie.)

model.constructionInvariantsNote: Architect INV-G1/INV-G2 (2026-07-20), pinned scenario-first (correct-by-construction): the expert EXTENDS the existing choke-point to cover both '/server-manager' + '/api/server-manager/*' via the one assertOwner guard, single OWNER_TOKEN literal. Architect verifies the choke-point extension when the expert ships the page. These back AC-shared-guard + AC-page-route; the tester asserts non-owner-403 on ALL surfaces (page + api + ws) against the single guard.
